methodology: Verify current 2026/27 squad membership before evaluating penalty evidence; reject rumours and completed departures.
Weight 2026 preseason and 2025/26 competitive in-match penalties above specialist projections and historical logs.
Use official club, LaLiga and RFEF material for membership and match confirmation wherever available.
Use Spanish national and local reporting to resolve coach designations, on-field decisions and chronology.
Label shootout-only evidence and do not treat it as proof of a regular-time hierarchy.
Force three practical current names per club while exposing unresolved roles through confidence, status and uncertainty notes.
Apply the requested Barcelona editorial override of Raphinha, Lamine Yamal and Anthony Gordon while recording that direct evidence supports a disputed committee.
